notes: §1985:XII.2.4 GR6: "Comment lines or blank lines occurring in the library text and in pseudo-text-1 are ignored for purposes of matching", the text words of library text and pseudo-text-1 follow the reference format, and comment or blank lines of pseudo-text-2 and of unmatched library text are copied unchanged (a listing matter with no effect on the object program). FixedFormConverter (reached for library text through NormalizeCopybookMapped and for the COPY statement itself through the source conversion) discards comment and blank lines and drops sequence and identification areas, so TextWordScanner never sees them and ApplyReplacements matches across them; at 85 a comment line written inside pseudo-text-2 is no forbidden result (ForbiddenIn sees only text).
